title: Senior Analytical Engineer
searchText: Senior Analytical Engineer Visa Company Description Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters — to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description We are seeking a forward-thinking and hands-on Senior Manager to lead our Analytics Engineering practice. In this high-impact role, you will act as the primary architect and lead developer for our analytics ecosystem. You will be responsible for migration of Cloud data and establishing Microsoft Fabric as our central analytics hub, and executing complex data pipelines. This is a technical leadership role for a builder. You will drive an AI-First methodology, leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development while designing data structures that power future AI Agents and LLMs. You will define the standards, write the core code, and own the technical roadmap. Responsibilities: Architecture & AI Strategy: Fabric Architecture: Design and implement the end-to-end Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) within Microsoft Fabric, ensuring data is structured not just for BI reporting, but optimized for AI/ML integration. Data for AI: Lead the strategy for building Data for AI pipelines—preparing unstructured text and data for vectorization, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and AI Agent consumption. AI-First Development: Champion the use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Copilot, Cline, Claude Code) to generate boilerplate code, write unit tests, and document logic, setting the standard for high-velocity development. Migration & Pipeline Execution: Hadoop Migration: Lead the technical strategy and execution of migrating on-prem Hadoop data to the Cloud (AWS/Azure) and connecting it to Fabric. Complex Pipeline Development: Build and maintain complex PySpark notebooks and data flows. Orchestrate data movement between on-prem, cloud, and hybrid data systems, specifically sourcing information from CRM/ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics or Salesforce. Legacy Integration: Utilize deep knowledge of Bash, Unix, and HDFS to interact with legacy systems during the migration phase. DevOps, Standards & Project Management: Code Quality & Governance: Act as the gatekeeper for the GitHub repository. Enforce strict CI/CD practices, manage branching strategies, and perform code reviews to ensure production-grade quality. Project Leadership: Manage the engineering roadmap using tools like Jira or Jira Align. Translate high-level business requirements from stakeholders into technical sprints and deliverables. Collaboration: Partner with the BI team to ensure Gold layer data models are optimized for downstream reporting and analysis. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. This role is not eligible for immigration/sponsorship, including but not limited to J-1, F-1, CPT, or OPT and employment-based sponsorship such as: H-1B, H-1B1,E-3, O-1, TN and any EAD card holders that may need assistance in the future. This role is not eligible for relocation. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD Preferred Qualifications: 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD Experience & Leadership: 7+ years of Analytical Engineering experience. Proven experience leading technical projects, architecture design, or migrations (formal people management experience is not required, but technical leadership is essential). Technical Mastery: Core Stack: Mastery of Python/PySpark, SQL, and Airflow. Legacy Stack: Expert familiarity with Bash, Unix, Hadoop, Hive, Trino, SSH, the terminal, and HDFS. Cloud & Platforms: Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, Synapse, and/or AWS. DevOps: Proficient in GitHub flows (Branching, Merging, Reverting), GitHub Actions, and Test-Driven Development (TDD). AI & Innovation: Demonstrated interest or experience in Generative AI (specifically tools like Cline and/or Claude Code) for building data foundations or process automation. Strong experience with context and prompt engineering, token management, and sub-agent management. Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate coding velocity and enforce coding standards. Additional Information Work Hours: Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements: This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements: This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law. Visa will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code. U.S. APPLICANTS ONLY: The estimated salary range for this position is $149,800- $240,100 to USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401 (k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.
